name: std::numpunct<CharT>::~numpunct
intro: Destructs a std::numpunct facet. This destructor is protected and virtual (due to base class destructor being virtual). An object of type std::numpunct, like most facets, can only be destroyed when the last std::locale object that implements this facet goes out of scope or if a user-defined class is derived from std::numpunct and implements a public destructor.
